hypothesis: A causal XML/Wiki recognizer can replace individually admitted structural fragments with reversible WRT-compatible opcodes in one continuous stream, saving at least 21000 canonical-10M counted bytes while reducing mature predictor steps and cycles.
interfaces_exposed: exact reversible macro registry with per-macro archive and cycle attribution
kill_condition: Retire v1 if no individual macro remains positive after source cost, if the frozen set misses 21000 canonical-10M bytes, or if step reduction does not reduce mature wall time.
promotion_condition: Each macro is positive under adjacent native archive replay; the frozen set saves at least 21000 counted bytes at canonical 10M, transfers positively to offset and page-family holdouts, roundtrips deterministically, and reduces mature cycles.
rejection_reason: The sole antecedent is terminal XML21: exact 10M archive regressed 872 bytes and its decision forbids adding patterns or combining the unchanged transform. No materially different macro family or positive native endpoint is specified, so the proposal is not actionable under its own per-macro promotion gate.
title: PHASECODE runtime-priced structural macro compilation
